business_problem: Criminals steal payment card numbers and post partial numbers on illegal websites, making it difficult to identify compromised cards and alert banks quickly enough to prevent fraud.
solution_summary: Mastercard scans transaction data across billions of cards and millions of merchants to surface new, complex fraud patterns, including partial card numbers posted on illegal websites. Its in-house generative AI-based predictive technology analyzes those signals to predict the full details of potentially compromised cards and identify merchants at risk. Mastercard uses the alerts to notify banks sooner and more accurately; banks can block and reissue affected cards, while attempted transactions on compromised cards are continuously monitored. The release describes transaction-data scanning, predictive analysis, alerting and ongoing monitoring, but does not name a separate ingestion platform, model-serving stack, data store or external software integrations. Cyber Secure is mentioned as an existing Mastercard security solution that profiles banks' and merchants' online cybersecurity, but the release does not say it implements this AI enhancement.

source_references.title: Mastercard accelerates card fraud detection with generative AI technology | Mastercard Caribbean

evidence_quotes: Mastercard is using generative AI to double the speed at which it can detect potentially compromised cards.
The new technology works by scanning transaction data across billions of cards and millions of merchants at faster rates than previously imaginable.
Using generative AI-based predictive technology built by Mastercard it is able to protect future transactions against emerging threats.
As a result of these enhancements, Mastercard alerts banks more quickly and with greater accuracy when a card is likely to have been compromised.
Attempted transactions on the compromised card can be continuously monitored to mitigate fraud and enhance cyber security.
